title: Generating Counter Narratives against Online Hate Speech: Data and Strategies
benchmark_measurement: Generating effective counter-narratives against online hate speech, with a significant number of examples focusing on anti-Muslim hate speech and stereotypes.
findings: The study found that fine-tuning GPT-2 on a high-quality, expert-curated dataset (NICHE) is effective for generating novel and diverse counter-narratives to hate speech. This includes producing fact-based, non-aggressive responses to anti-Muslim stereotypes, demonstrating the framework's applicability to religious hate speech.
